query: UPDATE assistant_uploads SET file_id=$4,size_bytes=coalesce($5,size_bytes),media_type=coalesce($6,media_type),sha256=coalesce($7,sha256),state=CASE WHEN $8 OR state IN ('cancelled','cleanup_pending') OR created_at<=now()-interval '60 seconds' THEN 'cleanup_pending' ELSE 'uploaded' END WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND session_id=$2 AND id=$3 AND state IN ('reserved','uploaded','cancelled','cleanup_pending') AND (file_id IS NULL OR file_id=$4) RETURNING jsonb_build_object('id',id,'file_id',file_id,'state',state,'size_bytes',size_bytes,'media_type',media_type,'sha256',sha256) AS "data!"
